description: Ex Fuerza Aérea del Perú Mirage 5P '103', to the FAA 5 June 1982 as C-419 (later C-619); fuselage installed with the fictitious serial C-433 of 1st Lt José Ardiles in a veterans' memorial space inaugurated 24 October 2019, alongside an AMX-13 tank. Photographed July 2024.
aliases: Mirage 5P; Mirage V; C-619; C-433; C619; C433
